content.comment_body: I'm currently developing a test program along with a corresponding web page. I first download the diagram to the [product_name] using [product_name]. Afterward, when trying to download the web page, I encounter an error message. Does anyone know what the issue could be? I have inserted and formatted a 1GB micro SD card as FAT32. The module is [product_name] [version_no] with firmware version [version_no] and article number [article_no].

The issue arises from using the incorrect version of the [product_name]. The extended web server functionality you require is only available with the newer [product_name] [version_no]. The order number in your case is [article_no]. For further details, please refer to the corresponding product note regarding the release of [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters an error when attempting to download a web page to a [product_name] module, even though the diagram was successfully transferred. The core problem relates to feature availability: the extended web server necessary for web page downloads is only supported in newer hardware versions than what the user currently has. This is a compatibility issue based on hardware and firmware versions, rather than an error on the user's part or a technical malfunction.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to download and utilize a custom web page on their [product_name] [version_no] module as outlined in the [document] documentation.
